Kidnapped | Baby Olothando

By: Sinethemba Nogude | Paid

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A baby kidnapped by a perfect stranger,a distraught mother and a hospital worker who went beyond the call of duty. We find out how an admin clerk solved a missing person's case that baffled the poli

Unique Selling Point:
The curious case of baby Olothanda!

When Noncedo Jali gave birth a healthy baby boy at Dora Nginza hospital, it was one of the happiest days of her...They called him Olothando...meaning" Of Love" ,but little did she know...horrific events were about to unfold just a few months later...

It was a morning like any other when Amahle came looking for assistance from the Jali family ...She had befriended Noncedo's sister and was in desperate need of Taxi fare....Willing to help Noncedo volunteered to help her ...and off they went to withdraw the money at a local shopping complex...for a split second Noncedo entrusted Olothando with Amahle....The next moment, both were gon...vanished...nowhere to be seen...

This would be 7 months of agony for the Jali Family, as police didnt have faith they would ever find baby Olothando.

And as fate would have it ...Dora Nginza admin clerk Portia Marinana was just having a normal workday... When an elderly woman walked in with a 7-month-old baby boy...the woman wanted help with getting proof of birth for the baby...The hospital is very stringent when it comes to such documents...When....When asked to produce the baby's Road-to Health booklet...everything was checking out...but having a keen eye...Portia realized that the mothers name had been erased and replaced...her instinct kicked in...there was something wrong...after investigating further...she was convinced that there was foul play...after doing an internet dive...she realised the missing baby Olothando might be the same baby that was brought...She tracked down the Jali family ...and the story was corroborated...In tears Noncedo broke down...her baby boy had been found...

Thanks to quick thinking by Portia and a bit of detective work...she was able to solve this cold case.

I think this would be a great story of how one woman's dedication to the job ....led to the recovery of a kidnapped baby...She will be cast as the protagonist of the story...I am busy trying to negotiate with the Jali family as Well as Portia...to be part of the story.

Extra day accommodation and transport in Port Elizabeth.

Script : Kidnapped baby Olothando

[ Opening sequence :Eerie drone background music ]

1.V/O Gqeberha in the Eastern Cape: an idyllic seaside location popular with tourists. In contrast, the New Brighton Township on the city’s outskirts is one of its most impoverished and violent areas, where life is a daily struggle.

2.V/O In November last year it was the scene of a shocking kidnapping involving a newborn baby… a crime that may well have gone unsolved were it not for the heroics of two vigilant hospital workers.

[ fade to black and into visuals of Dora Nginza hospital drone and interiors of hospital upsound]

Link: South African Health workers often make the headlines for the wrong reasons, It's easy to forget the many who often go beyond the call of duty…One family found some of those heroes in this hospital.
[visuals of hospital, nat sound]

3.V/O Dora Nginza Hospital is one of the busiest in Gqeberha, often the only facility that’s accessible to communities desperate for critical healthcare and social services.

4.V/O Staff here are under constant pressure; no better demonstrated than in the hospital's maternity ward, where eight-thousand babies are delivered each year.

Upsound Portia.//01:16:55 They aren't privileged. We have quite a number of people coming in and out on a daily basis. People coming from surrounding farms and sometimes as far as the rural areas.

5V/O It’s in this high pressure environment that social worker Portia Marinana has worked for over 4 years.

Upound Portia 01:08:16 Being a social worker is very rewarding,if you love seeing the change in people's lives.
6V/O Her office is always a hive of activity.

7.V/O But in June this year, what she thought was an ordinary day would embroil her in an incident that would later make national headlines.
Upsound Portia :01:12:24[ Pause] an elderly couple walked into my office. they introduced themselves as the grandparents of a seven-month-old baby that belonged to their son.
8.V/O The grandparents said they needed help to apply for the baby’s birth certificate because the child’s mother refused to register at Home Affairs. As they weren’t themselves the parents, Portia had to carefully review the case and verify their documents.
Upsound Portia 05:03I need to check whether this child was indeed born here in Dora. So they took out the road to health clinic card, the booklet of the child, and then the discharge summary.
9.V/O The Road to Health card is a booklet meant to track a baby’s development, including its health check-ups, and the discharge summary is a security document verifying that a patient has been cleared to leave the hospital premises.
10.V/O Portia found concerning discrepancies in both documents… Crucial information seemed to have been fraudulently altered using a correction pen.
Govan Question 06:13 Had you ever seen anything like that before?
Upsound Portia 05:48 No. The baby's name was tippexed off and was written with a pen. the child's birth date was tippexed off and then a new date of birth was written.The mother's details erased with the t-ppex and then rewritten with a pen. I knew something was wrong.
11V/O Portia had stumbled upon the first evidence in a sinister crime.
[ breather/ slow fade to black into visuals of Jali home in New Brighton ups]
12V/O In November last year Noncedo Jali gave birth to a healthy baby boy at Dora Nzinga. Her third child, she named him ‘Olothando’… meaning ‘’Born out of Love’...
Upsound Noncedo00:14:22 (Sigh) I was so happy, overly excited…00:16:11 If you feed him he will just sleep so peacefully.
13.V/O Her first few days with baby Olothando were joyful… but, sadly, short lived.
[dramatic pause]
14.V/O While in the maternity ward Noncedo met a woman who introduced herself as Asanda. Saying she was a patient expecting her first child in just a few months, she took a special interest in Olothando.
Upsound Noncedo 0:01:22 It seemed that she was about 5 months pregnant//00:01:33, the lady asked to see the baby and slightly removed what the he was covered with so that she can be able to see the face.
15.V/O When Noncedo and baby Olothando were discharged, Asanda offered to carry her bags and accompany her home.

Upsound Noncedo 00:03:24I agreed as the bag was very heavy and I was holding the baby too.
16V/ O Unaware of the coming tragedy, the two walked to a nearby shopping mall so Noncedo could withdraw money for a taxi home…
17.V/O She handed her baby to Asanda, before briefly turning away.
Upsound Noncedo 00:05:09 I went to sit down, and when I looked up she was no longer there with me.
[ tension visuals and sound]
18.V/O Noncedo searched frantically for Asanda and her missing baby, but they were nowhere to be found.
[breather]
Link : Weeks turned into months Here in their new Brighton home, anxiety was growing among the Jali family who were too scared to leave the house in case the police arrived with a new lead in the case.
19 As Noncedo’s nightmare was unfolding, Portia was digging deeper into the documents provided by the two strangers who’d sat in her office claiming to be a mystery baby’s grandparents.
[breather]
20 .V/O They listed the baby’s biological mother as Amahle Sigam, a patient Portia couldn’t find listed in any of the hospital’s maternity records.
Govan Question 06:58 : were Internal alarm bells going off?
Upsound Portia 07:50 I also was mindful of the fact that I don't want to accuse anyone and I wanted to get to the bottom of what was happening.
[ Kaamila at work]
Upsound Kaamila 04:11 immediately knew that is a red flag for me.
21V/O administration clerk Kaamilah Eagles has kept watch over the hospital’s patient records for more than 20 years. Portia asked her to help investigate whether an Amahle Sigam had given birth at the hospital…
22.V/O carefully examining the documents and cross-referencing the hospital’s birth records, she discovered that Sigam had never been a patient in the maternity ward.
23 V/O So, if Sigam wasn’t the baby’s mother… who was? Buried in his file, Kamilah found a crucial clue.
Upsound Kamilah05:58 So when I took the discharge paper...// Into the light, turned it around, and there was a name I saw there's a name. [ pause]
24.V/O… The baby’s mother was Noncedo Jali!
[ pause]
25.V/O Despite seven months of anxiety and trauma, Noncedo had been living in hope that she’d one day be reunited with her child..
Upsound Nonced 00:12:04 All along I had a feeling that my child was alive somewhere out there.
[breather build tension ]
26V/O So determined were Portia and Kamilah to place the final pieces of the puzzle, that they tracked down Noncedo Jali and immediately drove to her home In New Brighton…

27. At the house, Noncedo and her mother detailed the shopping centre kidnapping orchestrated by a woman who’d introduced herself as Asanda. This, Portia would later conclude, was the Amahle Sigam named as Olothando’s mother on the forged hospital records.
Upsound Portia 35:33 I was shocked. I couldn't even contain my emotions. I remember looking at Camilla. She was shocked as well.
Upsound Portia 37:08 I said to them, I have found your baby. The baby is safe.
Upsound Noncedo 00:11:18 This is when I jumped to go to where they were sitting, crying tears of joy // 00:12:16 My heart was now at ease.
27.V/O But what of the two people who’d come to Portia claiming to be Olothando’s paternal grandparents? It appears they, too, were victims in this shameful tale.
Question Govan 45:54 Did you know how you were going to approach the elderly lady who took care of the little boy.
Upsound Portia 54:29She was shocked. she kept on saying, no, this is my son's baby. The girlfriend stays with us. She was indeed pregnant.//56:50She was crying uncontrollably.
Upsound 46:05 I felt that they were also victims because I've witnessed how loving they were towards the boy.
28 V/O Sigam was arrested and charged with kidnapping and fraud and has appeared at the New Brighton Magistrates Court. The case is ongoing.

Upsound Portia 40:25 I don't think, to be quite honest, that she was ever pregnant.
[ fade to black build up to reunion emotional music]
29 V/O In June this year , Noncedo and baby Olothando were finally reunited.
[ cellphone footage of reunion]
.Upsound Noncedo 00:14:43 I held him so tight that I never wanted to let go ever again//00:14:47 It was a very joyful moment.
Upsound Portia 01:03:12 You know, she was crying, kissing the baby, finally she was holding her baby. So that was a very emotional moment that I'm so glad I was a part of
Upsound Noncedo 00:15:08 I am so thankful for what they have done for me00:15:11 May God keep them so that they can be able to assist even more people…


[end on reunion video]

[ Ending]

Promos 1
V/O Its a parent’s worst nightmare realised, your child being kidnapped.
Upsound Noncedo : 00:06:27 I didn’t even know where to start to look for my baby, I was just roaming

V/O For one mother , it took two unlikely detectives to find her missing 4-day old baby.
Upsound Portia 07:50 I wanted to get to the bottom of what was happening.

Promo 2

V/O Its a case that could make a best-selling crime novel , a 4-day baby kidnapping from its mother in plain sight.

Upsound Kaamila 07:36 I was doing my own little investigation //02:56 I immediately knew that something was off here.
V/O How did a social worker and an admin clerk, solve a cold case that baffled the police.


Promo 3

Upsound Portia 37:08 I said to them, I have found your baby. The baby is safe.
V/O It's a story that made the headlines, A social worker and an administration clerk solving a cold case of a kidnapped 4- day old baby . How did the two unlikely detectives crack the case?


Question Govan : 00:39Thank you. An incredible story unfolded here. Let's go through what happened.

Upsound Noncedo 00:15:50 Olothando is such a lovely child, always smiling and loves people //00:16:11 If you feed him he will just sleep so peacefully. [ visuals of Noncedo playing with baby]

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): A baby kidnapped by a perfect stranger,a distraught mother and a hospital worker who went beyond the call of duty. We find out how an admin clerk solved a missing person's case that baffled the poli
metadata.Unique Selling Point: The curious case of baby Olothanda! When Noncedo Jali gave birth a healthy baby boy at Dora Nginza hospital, it was one of the happiest days of her...They called him Olothando...meaning" Of Love" ,but little did she know...horrific events were about to unfold just a few months later... It was a morning like any other when Amahle came looking for assistance from the Jali family ...She had befriended Noncedo's sister and was in desperate need of Taxi fare....Willing to help Noncedo volunteered to help her ...and off they went to withdraw the money at a local shopping complex...for a split second Noncedo entrusted Olothando with Amahle....The next moment, both were gon...vanished...nowhere to be seen... This would be 7 months of agony for the Jali Family, as police didnt have faith they would ever find baby Olothando. And as fate would have it ...Dora Nginza admin clerk Portia Marinana was just having a normal workday... When an elderly woman walked in with a 7-month-old baby boy...the woman wanted help with getting proof of birth for the baby...The hospital is very stringent when it comes to such documents...When....When asked to produce the baby's Road-to Health booklet...everything was checking out...but having a keen eye...Portia realized that the mothers name had been erased and replaced...her instinct kicked in...there was something wrong...after investigating further...she was convinced that there was foul play...after doing an internet dive...she realised the missing baby Olothando might be the same baby that was brought...She tracked down the Jali family ...and the story was corroborated...In tears Noncedo broke down...her baby boy had been found... Thanks to quick thinking by Portia and a bit of detective work...she was able to solve this cold case. I think this would be a great story of how one woman's dedication to the job ....led to the recovery of a kidnapped baby...She will be cast as the protagonist of the story...I am busy trying to negotiate with the Jali family as Well as Portia...to be part of the story.
